findings.claim: Original 00405970 enters 00472220 to create the projection/camera record and copies 118 dwords to persistent 004C2730; native camera setup completes under synthetic 640×480 viewport with explicit FSINCOS and CRT 80-bit-to-int service substitutions.
findings.limitations: Camera pose is controlled, math services intercepted, not a complete retail frame or bit-identical x87 validation.

findings.claim: Original 0048F9B0 performs five allocator requests (370000, 128000, 49152, 49152, 2880 bytes), sets global work pointers and zeros two 4096×12-byte spatial tables; original instructions complete after 73,776 emulation steps.
findings.limitations: Allocator services substituted; no real DirectDraw surface or full render context initialized.

findings.claim: Original 0048F2B0 follows hlight-related node lookup from the world renderer, emits work discriminator 0x0A and bins it independently of ordinary type-6 world object traversal.
findings.limitations: hlight association established from static literal/call flow and native queue; complete headlight semantics/visibility not proven.

findings.claim: Original dispatch pointer index 10 at 004FACA8 points to executable 00490640 (not defined as a Ghidra v97 function), whose native geometry-face path executes for both GTSi and bus, reaches first face-depth check at 004906C0 and culls at 004907C5 without material or polygon submission in controlled synthetic view.
findings.limitations: Original renderer and VCF data with synthetic camera. First tested face culled; normal retail camera, actual texture acquisition and polygon submission remain untested.

findings.claim: Native default projection initialization alone does not establish dynamic player-follow camera pose, accurate spatial/visibility bounds, native x87 parity, or a fully rasterized frame.
findings.limitations: Requires original camera-mode update path and vehicle world simulation, original clip/draw and real material decoded images.
